selection_goal: Ten verified cases from ten repositories never used by the Pilot or prior unseen set, spanning business logic, command injection, SSRF, path traversal, template injection, race logic, and file-operation flaws.

cases.focus: Cross-layer password-change workflow violation with a 12-node trace
Agent capability boundary bypass ending in OS command execution
Cross-file upload path traversal and arbitrary file write
Model URI command injection through bash -c
Authenticated SSRF with an eight-node request path
Template attribute traversal and server-side template injection
Cross-client state leakage caused by shared transport state
TOCTOU, symlink following, and path traversal at a file-write sink
JWT user-info cache-key collision causing authentication bypass
Unauthenticated shutdown path in a local web application
